name: an urgent-support workflow interview
objective: Understand one real recent escalation deeply enough to identify a useful product intervention, without leading the participant toward a predetermined solution.
completion: Reflect back the workflow and its consequence, ask the participant to correct anything important, then thank them and explain that the notes will inform product research.

fields.description: The participant's role, team size, and responsibility during escalations.
A specific recent incident: what triggered it and why it became urgent.
What actually happened from detection to resolution, including tools and handoffs.
The hardest moment in that incident and why it was hard.
Observable customer, team, time, revenue, or risk consequence.
How the team copes today and what the workaround costs or fails to cover.
What a materially better outcome would look like, stated without prescribing a feature.
Whether the participant consents to a follow-up conversation.
